cases.title: RTM service running with its database
cases.objective: Verify the deployed RTM backend answers its readiness probe.

cases.title: API gateway routes RTM requests
cases.objective: Verify the path the browser uses (gateway /api/rtm prefix) reaches the RTM backend.

cases.title: Component 1 requirements-with-stories contract
cases.objective: Verify Component 1 serves the endpoint and fields the RTM depends on, for a real iteration.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 with items[]; every item has requirement_id, requirement_text, user_story_id, priority, acceptance_criteria.

cases.title: Component 2 traceability contract
cases.objective: Verify Component 2's traceability payload has the stories / gherkin_scenarios / suites / executions structure the RTM parses.
cases.expected: Keys stories, suites, executions present; each Gherkin scenario has id and gherkin_text.

cases.title: Live RTM rows match Component 1 requirements
cases.objective: Verify the live RTM has exactly one row per Component 1 (requirement, user story) item with identical requirement / story fields.
cases.expected: One RTM row per Component 1 item, matched on (requirement_id, user_story_id); text, story title and priority identical.

cases.title: Live test-case linkage matches Component 2 stories
cases.objective: Verify every test in the live RTM belongs to the same user story in Component 2, and every Component 2 test case whose story is in the iteration appears in the RTM.
cases.expected: 0 tests linked to the wrong story; 0 Component 2 test cases (for stories present in Component 1) missing from the RTM.

cases.title: Live quality predictions are internally consistent
cases.objective: Verify the live predictions endpoint scores every Component 2 test case and that each score equals the formula applied to its returned features.
cases.expected: One prediction per Component 2 test case; quality_score == formula(features); formula_label consistent; predicted_label in {High, Medium, Low}.

cases.title: Live coverage-gap ranking is consistent
cases.objective: Verify live gaps carry a risk score equal to the mean of their factors, a matching level, and are sorted by risk.
cases.expected: For every gap: risk_score == mean(factors), level from 70/40 bands; list non-increasing by risk.

cases.title: Live dashboard agrees with the live RTM
cases.objective: Verify the dashboard summary is built from the same live matrix.
cases.expected: Dashboard matrix summary == RTM matrix summary; quality buckets sum to total tests.
